It is currently a **generated production ontology**, not a temporary hand-written stub.  
The project replaced the temporary `ontologies/architecture.ttl` stub with Trivyn-generated files (`ontologies/software-architecture.ttl` + shapes) in the M2 rollout, so the stub has been retired【Rationale: Trivyn-generated production architecture ontology delivered; stub ontology retired (M2)】.
